brief: A water tracker: log glasses, with a daily goal of 8
A shopping list I add to by telling you, and tick off in the store
Weather in London now and for the next three days
Apple's stock price, kept up to date while it's open
The Hacker News front page; clicking a story opens it
A pomodoro timer: 25 minutes of work, then a 5 minute break
Remind me to stretch at 3pm on weekdays, and count the days I did
Convert US dollars to euros at today's rate
Track reading, meditating and running each day, with streaks
A packing list for a weekend trip that I can copy as text
A tip calculator: the bill, the tip and how many of us, set with the wheel
A little game where I steer a paddle with the wheel to catch falling dots, and it keeps my best score
An internet radio: pick a genre, then a station, and it keeps playing when I leave the app
Rain and white noise sounds to fall asleep to, with a sleep timer that stops them
A dice game: roll five dice and score them like Yahtzee, keeping my best game
A trip helper: pick a city and see its weather now and what 100 US dollars is in its local currency
A mortgage calculator: price, deposit, interest rate and years set with the wheel, showing the monthly payment and the total interest
A widget for my glance screen showing how many push-ups I did today and this week
A widget with the top 3 BBC News headlines
